verilog_input.description: input VERILOG file, provide circuit netlist information if it is not included in DEF file

num_bins_x.description: number of bins in horizontal direction

num_bins_y.description: number of bins in vertical direction

global_place_stages.description: global placement configurations of each stage, a dictionary of {"num_bins_x", "num_bins_y", "iteration", "learning_rate", "learning_rate_decay", "wirelength", "optimizer", "Llambda_density_weight_iteration", "Lsub_iteration"}

scale_factor.description: scale factor to avoid numerical overflow; 0.0 means not set

ignore_net_weight.description: ignore net weight larger than some value for weight_hpwl reporting

shift_factor.description: shift factor to avoid numerical issues when the lower-left origin of rows is not (0, 0);

ignore_net_degree.description: ignore net degree larger than some value

gp_noise_ratio.description: noise to initial positions for global placement

stop_overflow.description: stopping criteria, consider stop when the overflow reaches to a ratio

diagnostic_validation_on_high_overflow_f.description: continue finite high-overflow runs through validation and native scoring

exact_overlap_diagnostic_interval.description: accepted optimizer steps between exact anchor/keep-in overlap diagnostics; zero disables

detailed_place_engine.description: external detailed placement engine to be called after placement

detailed_place_command.description: commands for external detailed placement engine

RePlAce_ref_hpwl.description: reference HPWL used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_LOWER_PCOF.description: lower bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_UPPER_PCOF.description: upper bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

gamma.description: base coefficient for log-sum-exp and weighted-average wirelength, a relative value to bin size

RePlAce_skip_energy_flag.description: whether skip density energy computation for fast mode, may not work with some solvers

random_center_init_flag.description: whether perform random initialization for global placement

initial_placement_file.description: optional Bookshelf .pl file used to initialize physical node locations

initial_placement_strict.description: require an initial placement to contain every physical node with matching orientation

init_loc_perc_x.description: initial horizontal location of cells for global placement (% of layout width)

init_loc_perc_y.description: initial vertical location of cells for global placement (% of layout height)

sort_nets_by_degree.description: whether sort nets by degree or not

dump_global_place_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate global placement solution as a compressed pickle object

dump_legalize_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate legalization solution as a compressed pickle object

node_area_adjust_overflow.description: the overflow where to adjust node area

max_num_area_adjust.description: maximum times to adjust node area

adjust_nctugr_area_flag.description: whether use NCTUgr congestion map to guide area adjustment

adjust_rudy_area_flag.description: whether use RUDY/RISA map to guide area adjustment

adjust_pin_area_flag.description: whether use pin utilization map to guide area adjustment

unit_horizontal_capacity.description: number of horizontal routing tracks per unit distance

unit_vertical_capacity.description: number of vertical routing tracks per unit distance

unit_pin_capacity.description: number of pins per unit area

route_opt_adjust_exponent.description: exponent to adjust the routing utilization map

deterministic_flag.description: whether require run-to-run determinism, may have efficiency overhead

get_congestion_map.description: compute congestion map after placement complete

macro_overlap_weight.description: initial weight of macro overlap cost

macro_overlap_mult_weight.description: weight multiplier for MFP macro overlap

macro_padding_x.description: horizontal padding around macros for MFP macro overlap

macro_padding_y.description: vertical padding around macros for MFP macro overlap

bndry_padding_x.description: horizontal padding around the edges of the floorplan

bndry_padding_y.description: vertical padding around the edges of the floorplan

pin_density.description: target pin density for cells inflation

route_info_input.description: route information file (w. total H/V routing length & macro routing length contribution)

evaluate_pl.description: evaluate .pl file without running anything (e.g., to get baseline PPA)

risa_weights.description: whether use weighted smooth HPWL with RISA net weights

anchor_keepin_config.description: path to an optional anchor/irregular keep-in experiment config

anchor_keepin_flag.description: enable loading and validation of anchor/keep-in constraints

anchor_loss_weight_scale.description: deprecated one-shot anchor scale; accepted but ignored by adaptive control

anchor_gradient_ratio.description: target raw anchor-gradient to wirelength-gradient ratio

anchor_weight_update_interval.description: accepted iterations between anchor gradient-norm refreshes

anchor_weight_ema_decay.description: EMA decay for bounded anchor weight targets

anchor_weight_warmup_iterations.description: accepted iterations before anchor weight ramp begins

anchor_weight_ramp_iterations.description: accepted iterations used to ramp the anchor weight

anchor_keepin_initialization.description: anchor/keep-in initialization mode: legacy_pack_all, preserve_legal, project_illegal, or checkpoint_warm_start

feasible_domain_cache_dir.description: optional persistent cache directory for footprint-aware feasible domains

keepin_soft_loss_flag.description: enable soft distance penalty outside component feasible domains

irregular_density_flag.description: make side-specific electric density consume irregular keep-in capacity

irregular_density_require_feasible_targe.description: fail when irregular usable area cannot support target density

keepin_soft_loss_weight_scale.description: scale applied to gradient-norm-matched interior keep-in margin weight

keepin_margin_mm.description: interior keep-in safety margin in millimeters

keepin_margin_tau_mm.description: softplus transition width for the keep-in margin in millimeters

footprint_collision_loss_flag.description: enable the side-local footprint configuration-space collision barrier

collision_margin_mm.description: requested collision clearance margin in millimeters

collision_tau_mm.description: softplus transition width for the footprint collision barrier in millimeters

collision_gradient_ratio.description: target collision-gradient to wirelength-gradient ratio on active coordinates

collision_weight_update_interval.description: accepted iterations between collision gradient-norm refreshes

collision_weight_ema_decay.description: EMA decay for bounded collision weight targets

collision_weight_warmup_iterations.description: accepted iterations before collision pressure begins

collision_weight_ramp_iterations.description: accepted iterations used to ramp collision pressure

exact_step_guard_flag.description: reject exact-illegal optimizer proposals before accepting a native step

exact_step_guard_backoff.description: multiplicative optimizer step-size backoff after an exact-illegal proposal

exact_step_guard_max_retries.description: maximum native optimizer retries after exact-illegal proposals

collision_pair_diagnostics_flag.description: record bounded pair-local collision gradients and proposal motion for guarded steps

exact_contact_projection_flag.description: project exact-crossing contact components onto bounded shared native proposal motion

exact_contact_projection_max_iterations.description: maximum exact contact-closure projection iterations per native proposal

exact_contact_projection_max_nodes.description: maximum cumulative active nodes selected for exact contact-consensus correction in one native proposal; crossing endpoints remain separately reported and inactive references do not consume the budget

keepin_projection_flag.description: project constrained components into footprint-aware feasible domains

constraint_grid_mm.description: site grid in millimeters for conservative feasible domains

keepin_clearance_mm.description: extra per-side footprint clearance in millimeters

freeze_anchor_nodes.description: freeze movable physical anchor nodes at source coordinates

allow_region_reassignment.description: allow an experiment driver to replace infeasible seed assignments

exact_repair_flag.description: run bounded footprint-aware repair after global placement
